title: Add your team — users and roles
description: Add colleagues with their own sign-in and the right level of access. Settings -> Users. New accounts get a temporary password; the user sets their own on first sign-in. The Create button is HOVERED, not clicked, so no real account is made on camera. Selectors: .tab[data-tab=users], #users-list, #btn-add-user reveals #add-user-form (#new-user-username, #new-user-display-name, #new-user-role edit|readonly|admin, #btn-save-user). Not the LAN search client — out of scope for this series.

steps.narration: ScanFinder isn't just for one person. You can add your colleagues, each with their own sign-in and their own level of access.
steps.caption: Add your team

steps.narration: Open Settings from the side bar.
steps.caption: 1. Open Settings

steps.narration: Here's everyone who can sign in. You start as the Admin, and you add the rest of your team here.
steps.caption: Who can sign in

steps.narration: Give them a username to sign in with,
steps.caption: A username

steps.narration: and the name you'll see them by.
steps.caption: Their name

steps.narration: Then choose their role. Admin can change everything, including users and settings. Edit can bring in documents and correct them. Read Only can search and view, but change nothing.
steps.caption: Admin · Edit · Read Only

steps.narration: Click Create. They get a one-time password and set their own the first time they sign in.
steps.caption: 4. Create the account

steps.narration: Give everyone just the access they need — your filing stays both easy to share and safe.
steps.caption: The right access for everyone
